review.notFound: Suggestion not found or you do not have access
review.author: Suggested by
review.noChanges: This suggestion is not split by measure
review.structuralNote: This suggestion changes the score structure (staves, key or time), so it is not split by measure: it can only be accepted as a whole.
review.conflict: The main score changed this measure after the suggestion; accepting will replace it
review.staleVersion: The main score has a newer version since this suggestion (it changes structure, so it cannot be applied).
review.staleStructure: The number of measures or parts in the main score changed, so this cannot be applied. Reject it and ask the author to redo it.
review.staleContext: The key, time or clef of the main score changed around these measures, so this cannot be applied. Reject it and ask the author to redo it.
